title: Change identity relied on color
observed: Screenshots28/29 show plain changed text without plus/minus; parser removed prefixes and rows lacked kind semantics.
impact: Readers could mistake addition for removal in grayscale or through screen readers.
proposal: Dedicated plus/minus column and localized added/removed/unchanged line semantics.
verification: Semantics and visible symbol tests pass; normal and2.5x actual-font widget captures inspected. Native TalkBack remains pending.

title: Change rail was a three by one pixel dash
observed: The source used width3 with SizedBox(height:1), also visible in screenshot29.
impact: A nearly invisible dash failed to group wrapped changed code.
proposal: Paint a3dp leading border spanning the rendered row, including wraps.
verification: Wrapped-row geometry check and actual-font captures confirm continuous rail.

title: Context expansion was undersized and irreversible in place
observed: Source had32dp gap InkWell, ambiguous +N lines label, and no collapse action once context was revealed.
impact: Repeated precision taps and loss of the compact review make navigation harder.
proposal: Use48dp minimum controls with named reveal direction/count, and Hide revealed context action.
verification: Expand20 lines then collapse returns to changed line; minimum target verified. No context expansion ADB capture yet.

title: Unavailable patch context looked like available or added lines
observed: Patch gaps used +N lines even when omitted context could not be expanded.
impact: User can confuse skipped context with additions or attempt a dead control.
proposal: State that unchanged lines are not included in the patch; keep it noninteractive.
verification: Patch gap test verifies missing-context wording and absence of expansion control.

title: Fixed file header could not accommodate scaled identity
observed: Filename, path, status and counts shared one ellipsized44dp header.
impact: File identity is lost earlier with long names and large text.
proposal: Separate emphasized two-line name from path/counts; measure sticky height using current text scale; tooltip exposes full path.
verification: 320dp at2.5x layout passes; font-loaded400dp normal/2.5x captures inspected. Very long names still cap at2lines; full path is in tooltip.

title: Copy gave no completion feedback
observed: Copy called Clipboard.setData with no local success or failure feedback.
impact: The tap appears inert and encourages repeated copying.
proposal: Confirm whether updated file or patch was copied; provide failure recovery text.
verification: Mock clipboard receives updated content; success appears; Close returns to caller. Native clipboard failure not exercised.

title: Patch-only counts incorrectly displayed zero changes
observed: Real-font capture fixture with a patch and no supplied count rendered+0−0 despite one added and one removed row. FileDiff.counts only derives from before/after.
impact: Review summary contradicts the actual changed code.
proposal: Preserve supplied counts; derive missing counts from the parsed rows in the owned reader.
verification: Patch-only regression asserts+1 and−1; final normal and large captures show correct counts.

title: Wrap preference differs from other code readers
observed: Diff wraps below600dp and horizontally scrolls above; no user toggle.
impact: User cannot choose column alignment on a phone or wrapping on a large screen.
proposal: Consider shared wrap preference after cross-reader interaction contract is settled.
verification: Current responsive defaults preserved and tested. Deferred to coordinated reader consistency rather than adding toolbar density.

title: Filename repeated in route and file header
observed: Actual-font normal capture repeats the same basename in the appbar and immediately below in the file header.
impact: Duplicate hierarchy consumes attention and makes the small reader feel heavier.
proposal: Use localized Review as the route title and keep file identity, path and counts in its adaptive sticky header. Preserve copy and path tooltip.
verification: Pinned Flutter gen-l10n completed; final7/7 focused tests pass; normal and2.5x actual-font rasters inspected and confirm one filename with Review route title. Full-path tooltip, copy/navigation and counts remain covered.
